items.title: Ukrainian monitors warn of possible missile strikes on Kyiv infrastructure
items.summary: Ukrainian monitoring channels reportedly issued a 48-hour ballistic-missile threat alert, naming several Kyiv bridges, thermal power plants and the Nyvky substation as potential targets. The warning describes a possible attack, not strikes that have occurred.

items.title: Musk says Ukraine's front depends on Starlink connectivity
items.summary: Elon Musk said Ukraine's military front would collapse immediately without Starlink, underscoring the satellite network's role in Ukrainian military communications. His statement is an assessment, not a reported change to Starlink service.
